title: Belfry of Bruges
geometryBasis: Mapped tower and market hall with open central courtyard, the exact public-domain Qualla original, city height and lean, and original source terrain.
sectionBasis: Three receding tower stages rise from the brick market hall. The lower square work carries a corbelled arcade, the middle gallery has Gothic paired windows and corner pinnacles, and the final octagonal stage has clocks, tall bell openings and an open crown.
limitations: The model covers the 2005 belfry and market hall exterior around the courtyard. The 83 m height, one-meter southeast lean and mapped outlines set the principal controls.
Stage heights, the courtyard galleries, rear fenestration, roof details and Gothic ornament are estimated or simplified.
